name: SHUFFLE! Love Rainbow
source:
[i][b]Beyond this summer love, may our future be bright... Like a beautiful rainbow in the sky.[/b][/i]

It's summertime, and love is again blossoming for Tsuchimi Rin and the girls he's grown close to. This fan disc is a sweet treat for fans, offering a collection of romantic after-stories. Here's a taste of what's in store:

[b]Lishia and Kikyo's Divine Holiday (After the Lishia/Kikyo ending of SHUFFLE! Essence+)[/b]: The King of the Gods, eager to see his daughters find happiness with Rin, sends them all on a trip to the divine realm. But his idea of a romantic getaway might differ slightly from what the girls expect...

[b]Kaede's Sweet Summer (After Kaede regains her memories in Really? Really!)[/b]: Rin and Kaede spend their first summer together, and things get pretty sugary. Their relationship is overflowing with sweet moments, maybe even a little too sweet for their own good.

[b]Primula's Sisterly Seduction[/b]: Primula's emotions have blossomed, and she's head over heels for her "Onii-chan" Rin. She's always looking for ways to make him happy, and this time, she's turning to Asa and Kareha for advice.

[b]Ruri Matsuri's What If? Romance[/b]: Ruri Matsuri, the cross-dressing student council president from SHUFFLE! Essence+ finally joins the circle of girls around Rin. This story explores an alternate timeline in which their first encounter turns different.

Get ready to dive into a heartwarming collection of love stories filled with tender moments, exciting new beginnings, and plenty of fan service!

[Based on [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=702628/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
[i][b]愿这个夏日恋情之后的未来，像天际美丽的彩虹般灿烂……[/b][/i]

盛夏时节，土见稟与亲近的少女们再次迎来萌发的恋情。这张Fan Disc为粉丝献上甜蜜点心，收录一系列恋爱后日谈：

[b]莉希安瑟斯与桔梗的神界假日（《SHUFFLE! Essence+》莉希安瑟斯／桔梗结局之后）[/b]：众神之王急着见女儿们与稟共获幸福，便送大家前往神界旅行。不过，他对浪漫假期的理解或许与少女们稍有不同……

[b]枫的甜蜜夏日（《Really? Really!》中枫恢复记忆之后）[/b]：稟与芙蓉枫共度第一个夏天，日子甜得不得了。他们的关系满溢甜蜜时刻，或许甜得对两人而言都有些过头。

[b]普莉姆拉的妹妹式诱惑[/b]：普莉姆拉的情感已经萌芽，她深深爱上“哥哥”稟，总在寻找令他开心的方法。这次，她向时雨亚沙和卡蕾哈寻求建议。

[b]瑠璃·祭的假如恋情[/b]：来自《SHUFFLE! Essence+》、女装的学生会长瑠璃·祭终于加入稟身边的少女圈。这段故事探索一条不同时间线：他们的初遇走向了不一样的结果。

准备沉浸在这组温暖的恋爱故事中，感受温柔时刻、令人心动的新开始，以及满满的粉丝服务！

[根据[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=702628/]Getchu[/url]的介绍改编]
